scope: Tool-capability boundary for page264 acceptance. No WordPress write and no browser mutation.
purpose: Separate implementation defects from evidence that cannot be obtained with the currently available/disconnected tools, preventing speculative CSS/JS or scope expansion.

current_tool_state.wpvibe: disabled/unavailable on the single first attempt in continuation v015; no retry
current_tool_state.opera: Browser not connected on the single list-tabs attempt in continuation v015; no retry, navigation, screenshot or new tab
current_tool_state.github: available for repository read/write of evidence and planning artifacts only

opera_connector_capabilities_when_connec.consequence: A connected Opera session can provide synchronized AX/static visual evidence, but this connector alone cannot execute the full review/range/carousel/FAQ interaction matrix or prove exact winning CSS declarations.

server_state.requires: working WPVibe or another authorized WordPress connector

static_visual_and_ax.requires: connected trusted source+target browser pair, at most two tabs

computed_cascade.requires: browser/devtools or equivalent computed-style and winning-rule capability
computed_cascade.safe_fallback: Use only already parser-checked source-contract candidates after fresh visual reproduction; never invent a narrower patch from screenshot inference.

active_interaction.requires: browser capable of click, keyboard, pointer drag/swipe and timed observation
active_interaction.safe_fallback: Remain proof-only; do not create duplicate handlers.

deterministic_pixel_acceptance.requires: same engine plus controlled viewport, DPR, zoom, font/image readiness, scroll and motion state; synchronized moving content; captures plus overlay/diff

implementation_status_not_changed_by_mis: No known page264 content/main-media gap; 5/5 main media roles reconciled.
38/38 heading names and 11/11 ordered named regions accepted.
v004/v005 accepted live state remains preserve-only.
Only v006 contact foreground and v007 comparison equal-column parity are reproduced conditional page264-local visual write candidates.
Hero, inner form, review/Tiszafa/Nordmann/FAQ, dock and six-view matrix stay diagnostic/proof lanes until fresh evidence demonstrates an implementation failure.
future_acceptance_rule: When stronger tooling becomes available, gather the missing evidence first and compare source/target in synchronized state. New implementation work is authorized only by a reproduced mismatch with a named current owner; evidence unavailability alone never authorizes a fix.
